pieces.h: Exam Details
pieces.t: South Carolina electrical exam details depend on the license or credential being pursued. Candidates preparing for electrical contractor work should review the requirements of the South Carolina contractor licensing authority that applies to their project type and scope. Candidates preparing for a local master electrician or journeyman credential should review the rules issued by the city, county, municipality, or authority having jurisdiction. South Carolina electrical contractor exam preparation may include both trade knowledge and business-related licensing knowledge. The trade portion focuses on electrical theory, National Electrical Code application, installation requirements, safety, services, feeders, branch circuits, wiring methods, grounding and bonding, equipment, calculations, and practical electrical work. Business-related preparation may include contractor responsibilities, contracts, project management, insurance, financial responsibility, safety, labor issues, and regulatory compliance.
